title: On Generalization across Measurement Systems: LLMs Entail More Test-Time Compute for Underrepresented Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM factual recall accuracy (using Mean Absolute Percentage Deviation) and test-time compute costs when prompting models to output facts using alternative, culturally-specific measurement systems (e.g., local currencies, traditional weight and length units) compared to predominant Western defaults (e.g., USD, Kilograms, Miles).

Mapping the models' factual retrieval performance for various local currencies and categorizing the results by the respective countries' income levels (using World Bank classifications) to reveal performance disparities between high-income and low-income countries.

Aligning the prompt language with the native language of the measurement system (e.g., using Korean prompts for Korean currency queries) to isolate whether performance degradation is driven by the language of the prompt or the measurement system itself.
